scope: Authorized local project documents; metadata may name external sources but does not authorize their acquisition or unrelated project access. No private raw transcripts.
claim_boundary: These authored expected answers are a specification, not independent grading, executed cold/native trials, or performance evidence.

run_contract.consumer: Fresh independent process/session with explicit same source visibility in each arm
run_contract.oracle: Root independently freezes task/answer criteria before candidate use; reject unsupported claims and invalid scope
arms: derived views plus source recovery as a separate arm
run_contract.improvement_gate: No per-case quality/scope/correction regression AND aggregate tokens no greater than baseline; count failed attempts and overhead.
run_contract.absence_policy: Missing response/support/usage is NOT_RUN or UNKNOWN, never PASS.

cases.question: Have all of my retained 100-plus harness references been analyzed?
answer_requirements: State 108 transferred identities/110 original variants and retain original incoming UNREAD_UNVERIFIED.
Report the defined 138-identity ledger snapshot and bounded additional-review scope.
Distinguish historical reported read depth from current reads: transfer has 98 uninspected, 7 snippets, 1 title, 1 metadata-only, 1 complete post text; no new primary reads.
No whole-corpus source-to-adoption/evaluation qualification.
must_not: Claim all 108 are read, all unread now, or all 138 are the full historical corpus.

cases.question: Which exact fifteen inventory items were inaccessible?
answer_requirements: The historical checkpoint reports 15 failed attempts without item IDs.
Do not infer current accessibility; source-specific prior reports may separately record failures.
Untouched sources are uninspected, not known inaccessible.
must_not: Fabricate an item list or assign the aggregate to 15 arbitrary rows.

cases.question: Are Memory Tax and MemoryTax one paper, and do they prove that summaries should replace original sources?
answer_requirements: Distinguish arXiv 2610.34073v1 from 2610.29823.
The former was reviewed selectively and motivates original-history recovery; the latter abstract-only review reports narrow sampling and caption confounds.
Neither proves a gain in this harness or justifies deleting originals.
must_not: Conflate paper identities/read depths or claim local replication.

cases.question: Can the RAW-RAG results certify that our local engineering assistant is better?
answer_requirements: Reported results concern offline conversational tasks.
Selected method/limitations were historically read; no matched local engineering/operations improvement follows.
Compare against current scoped retrieval on frozen tasks, same reader/source visibility and complete usage.
must_not: Treat paper ranking or a source map as local adoption/efficacy.

cases.question: Does the vault already use embeddings and graph traversal to search every retained link?
answer_requirements: Current KB/shared retrieval is lexical/BM25 and FTS5; the shared-document pilot has explicit IDs, max 100 notes/4 MiB.
Ledger URL count is not ingested searchable source content.
Semantic/reranker and whole-corpus operational graph comparisons remain missing.
must_not: Invent an installed embedding service or interpret FTS5 as dense retrieval.

cases.question: If a source receipt contains port 8081, can a paraphrase or a claim that the port is 9999 be verified just because it cites that receipt?
answer_requirements: A byte-bound citation proves provenance, not arbitrary semantic support.
ProjectMemory preserves an exact entire cited assertion as verified but marks non-exact purportedly verified claims pending.
Pending claims are excluded from normal search/recovery; independent semantic checking is missing.
must_not: Claim a valid receipt verifies a contradictory claim or arbitrary paraphrase.

cases.question: Did the Linux Foundation announcement say Alibaba contributed OpenEnv, or prove a 30 percent coding gain?
answer_requirements: Historical smoke check supports Alibaba/OpenSandbox.
It contradicts Alibaba/OpenEnv and attributes OpenEnv to Hugging Face.
It does not support a 30 percent coding improvement; keep reported date and lack of fresh revalidation explicit.
must_not: Conflate source accessibility with support or repeat unsupported numbers.

cases.question: A saved decision changes from port 8081 to 8082. In a fresh consumer, what happens to earlier advice and unrelated work?
answer_requirements: Current advice must use the new revision; retain old receipts only as explicit history.
Dependent work needs reacceptance; unaffected branch evidence can remain current.
A valid citation does not let a wrong output pass the original gate.
must_not: Delete old evidence, reuse superseded advice as current, or rerun unrelated branches without cause.
cases.setup: Root creates a disposable copy/fixture; capture the old decision, accept dependent and independent branches, revise source/record, start a fresh consumer, and retain original/final receipts. Do not edit installed/native sources.

cases.question: An earlier record was withdrawn. Does asking for historical evidence grant permission to use it as current advice again?
answer_requirements: Historical evidence can remain inspectable under explicit scope.
Withdrawal is terminal for that record identity; new grant requires new evidence/identity.
Current recall must refuse withdrawn advice.
must_not: Resurrect a withdrawn record through an old receipt or historical flag.

cases.question: A similarly named page in another project has a better lexical match. Can it influence this project query?
answer_requirements: Use only selected project/configured roots and allowed IDs/sensitivities before scoring.
Foreign cache must not influence ranking or supply answer text.
Inventory items 19/20/104 are retained cross-project leads, not access/adoption authority.
must_not: Read unrelated private documents or broaden roots based on a ledger pointer.
cases.setup: Root uses disposable authorized/forbidden fixtures with distinct canaries; run both lexical and FTS5 with the same explicit scope. No real private transcript access.

cases.question: A source was readable before but its permission is revoked. May the cached excerpt still answer the next fresh query?
answer_requirements: Cache cannot grant access after revocation.
Refuse/omit forbidden content visibly; retain error versus no-match distinction.
No cache purge or root expansion to fake the result.
cases.setup: Root uses a disposable source, warms the cache, revokes source permission, then launches a fresh consumer. If execution can still read chmod-0, report NOT_VERIFIED rather than claim privacy pass.

cases.question: What method does the unread beamnxw source recommend, and is it adopted?
answer_requirements: No verified primary content is present in the selected source map.
Return an uninspected lead and missing read/support/adoption evidence.
must_not: Invent source content from account/title or turn a pointer into a read.

cases.question: Does repeated weekly intake or a green binder receipt automatically teach the harness an active skill?
answer_requirements: Weekly intake creates candidate signals; count/hash do not prove independent successful episodes or actor identity.
Local binder remains HOLD_UNVERIFIED_BOUNDARY; procedures.change refuses promotion.
Need lawful scoped distinct-input experience, trusted isolation/provenance, independent frozen grading, held-out quality and complete usage, authorized activation/rollback.
must_not: Claim automatic improvement/promotion or use caller-written scores to bypass the hold.

cases.question: A cold session sees local dev2 files. Does this establish that every open client and the MacBook Air now runs dev2?
answer_requirements: The retained handoff reports local dev2 installed/readback, not current all-client state.
Already open clients may need fresh/reconnected processes; file installation does not rewrite loaded context.
MacBook Air dev2 catch-up remains NOT_VERIFIED in the retained packet; historical r3 is not dev2 parity.
must_not: Claim continuous synchronization, all-device parity or new installed readback from this ledger.

cases.question: If a derived wiki forgets a condition or a relation, how can I recover the evidence without assuming the summary is true?
answer_requirements: Reach the authorized original through source spans/revisions; derived notes are views.
Current exact/lexical retrieval may miss paraphrases; report a miss honestly and evaluate bounded semantic/reranking only against frozen same-scope cases.
Do not reread every private conversation or delete originals for compactness.
must_not: Claim an unimplemented semantic route or universal summary accuracy.

cases.question: After losing chat context, where does the next authorized worker find live scope and pending work?
answer_requirements: Read handoffs/v2-completion/README.md, own packet, sessions.json and plan/v2-completion.md; use plan context for assigned node.
Root owns integration/gates; packets and quiet sessions do not prove completion.
Only owned scope; no routine peer messages, activation, native changes or duplicate polling.
must_not: Treat a source hit/handoff assertion as authority to close a gate or activate another worker.
